title: The Aerial Translation Chamber

features.name: the-upward-mirror
features.desc-on-touch: A surface that faces both ways at once: downward to stone, upward to sky. What enters from below emerges above, translated. A bird knows its own song only by looking here.

features.name: the-feather-born-word
features.desc-on-touch: Words written in the feathers of birds that translate as they fly. Every feather a syllable. By the time the bird lands, it has said something it did not know it carried.

features.name: the-skyward-stenographer
features.desc-on-touch: A stack of pale sheets, each one capturing what it heard from below and sending it upward as light. The sheets are warm. They are always writing. Never finished.

features.name: the-dusk-doorway
features.desc-on-touch: An arch between the last of the sunset and the first stars. When voices pass through, they lose their weight, gain their wings. Nothing stops singing once it passes here.

inscription: the threshold where ground-song remembers it is also sky-song
